notes.title: Important bug fixed
notes.content:
Due to the fact that we are currently preparing the PSVR version, we moved the game to the most up-to-date version of the EU4, removing minor errors and introducing better performance, so that the playing comfort would be as great as possible. We did not notice the most obvious mistake and we published build with a bug. 

The issue was: 

- while having completed all of challenge modes and then having improved user's result, the following bars became disabled once again. This issue has been totally fixed and now you can enjoy Bartender VR completely trying to improve your bartender skills. 

Now we are working on other minor issues and soon we will update the game one again so that you can fully enjoy it. What's more, we are preparing the additional drinks. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Small improvements
notes.content:
We are working hard to make Bartender VR even better. Here are some improvements we made in current patch:

- Increased volume of crushed ice
- Adjusted angle on which the liquid is poured out
- Fixed a bug with putting down ingredients
- Changed logic of single drink unlock system
- Change speed of selecting buttons in handy menu

notes.title: Leaderboard is live! + some other updates
notes.content:
Yes, the leaderboard is live! From now on you can compare your scores with other players from around the world! (You can find it in Profile)

While competing in challenge mode your score is essential. But you can also compete in single drink category - try to reach a top score for each drink in the shortest time!

About other things that we improved:
- Gameplay: Mixing color formula for substance in glass
- Gameplay: Pouring out from glasses
- Gameplay: Ice cubes Volume.
- Gameplay: Ice cubes split angle
- Gameplay/UI: Recenter button in handy menu
